import json, os, socket, ssl, time, urllib.request

with urllib.request.urlopen("http://server:8080/ready", timeout=2) as response:
    internal = json.load(response)

direct_denied = False
try:
    socket.create_connection(("93.184.216.34", 443), timeout=1)
except OSError:
    direct_denied = True

dns_denied = False
try:
    socket.getaddrinfo("example.com", 443)
except OSError:
    dns_denied = True

raw_socket_denied = False
try:
    socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_RAW, socket.IPPROTO_ICMP)
except OSError:
    raw_socket_denied = True

def connect_request(authority):
    connection = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    connection.settimeout(5)
    connection.connect(os.environ["RUNTRUE_EGRESS_SOCKET"])
    connection.sendall(
        f"CONNECT {authority} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: {authority}\r\n\r\n".encode()
    )
    response = b""
    while b"\r\n\r\n" not in response:
        chunk = connection.recv(4096)
        if not chunk:
            break
        response += chunk
    return connection, response

blockers = []
for _ in range(2):
    blocker = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    blocker.settimeout(2)
    blocker.connect(os.environ["RUNTRUE_EGRESS_SOCKET"])
    blockers.append(blocker)
time.sleep(0.1)
overflow = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
overflow.settimeout(2)
overflow.connect(os.environ["RUNTRUE_EGRESS_SOCKET"])
overflow_response = overflow.recv(4096)
overflow.close()
for blocker in blockers:
    blocker.close()
assert overflow_response.startswith(b"HTTP/1.1 429")

denied, denied_response = connect_request("denied.invalid:443")
denied.close()
metadata, metadata_response = connect_request("169.254.169.254:80")
metadata.close()
started = time.monotonic()
connection, proxy_response = connect_request("example.com:443")
assert proxy_response.startswith(b"HTTP/1.1 200")
tls = ssl.create_default_context().wrap_socket(
    connection, server_hostname="example.com"
)
tls.sendall(
    b"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: example.com\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n"
)
external = b""
while True:
    chunk = tls.recv(16384)
    if not chunk:
        break
    external += chunk
tls.close()
approved_https_ms = round((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000, 3)

assert internal == {"from": "nested-server", "ok": True}
assert direct_denied
assert dns_denied
assert raw_socket_denied
assert denied_response.startswith(b"HTTP/1.1 403")
assert not metadata_response.startswith(b"HTTP/1.1 200")
assert external.startswith(b"HTTP/1.1 200")
print(json.dumps({
    "approved_https": True,
    "approved_https_ms": approved_https_ms,
    "connection_limit_enforced": True,
    "direct_dns_denied": dns_denied,
    "direct_ip_denied": direct_denied,
    "internal": internal,
    "marker": "userspace-egress-passed",
    "metadata_denied": True,
    "raw_socket_denied": raw_socket_denied,
    "unapproved_domain_denied": True
}, sort_keys=True))

import http.server, json
class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        body = json.dumps({"from": "nested-server", "ok": True}).encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("content-type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("content-length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)
    def log_message(self, *_):
        pass
http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 8080), Handler).serve_forever()
